## Description

Uses Neural Controlled Differential Equations (Neural CDEs) to process irregularly sampled limit order book time series as continuous streams driven by rough path controls for predictive trend signals.

## Where it may fit

Irregular tick sampling environments, high-frequency limit order book trend breakout prediction.

## Vehicles

High-frequency trading (HFT) firms, statistical arbitrage proprietary desks.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message streams, trade execution timestamps.

## Caveats

Requires efficient ODE solvers and continuous path interpolation (e.g., cubic splines) during preprocessing.
